name: VibeCAD 26.3.1-RC6 (Build 6)
body:
VibeCAD 26.3.1-RC6 (Build 6) is a preview release.

Validated packages included in this release:
- Linux AppImage for direct execution.
- Linux Debian package.
- Windows installer executable.
- macOS Apple Silicon DMG.
- macOS Intel DMG.

Preview publication is best-effort by platform; unavailable packages are omitted.
Every included package has a SHA-256 checksum, a canonical update manifest, and GitHub build provenance. Published release assets and their tag are immutable.
